SENATE (ELECTION) RULES, 1975
SENATE (ELECTION) RULES,
1975
(Amendment of para (1) of Form
I)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
9th September, 2011]
S.R.O.827(I)/2011,
dated 25-8-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 88 of the
Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), the Federal Government, in
consultation with the Election Commission, is pleased to direct that the
following further amendment shall be made in the Senate (Election) Rules, 1975,
namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, in Form-I, in paragraph (I), for the words
"Ulema/Technocrats or women" the words and comma
"Ulema/Technocrats, Women or non-Muslims" shall be substituted.
